title: Investors flock to Anthropic IPO but question durability of AI lead
summary: The Anthropic roadshow is scheduled to run through next Wednesday, when the AI company is expected to price the $64 billion deal. Anthropic and its investment banks are meeting prospective investors in New York, Boston and San Francisco to gauge demand for the offering, one of the people and a third person familiar with the matter said.
llm_summary: Investors are lining up for Anthropic’s upcoming IPO, with the company and its banks holding a roadshow in New York, Boston and San Francisco ahead of the expected $64 billion pricing next Wednesday. While demand appears strong, analysts are questioning whether Anthropic can sustain its current AI advantage over rivals.
